name: item-dimension-readout-simple
description: IXT-SUITES simple rung for the `itemDimensionReadout` flag (simple tier): drives the real `resizeReadoutSignal` module (the exact signal `ResizeGizmo` writes on every group-resize pointermove tick) to publish a live width x depth, verifies `ResizeHud` renders the formatted readout pill while the signal is live and unmounts it when cleared, then verifies the pill never mounts at all with the flag forced off even while the signal is live.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: assert-no-readout-at-rest
steps.eval: (function(){ if (document.querySelector('.drag-readout')) throw new Error('drag-readout pill visible with no resize in progress'); })()

steps.name: publish-resize-signal
steps.eval: (async () => { const m = await import('/src/scene/selection/resizeReadoutSignal.ts'); window.__resizeSignal = m; m.setResizeReadout({ w: 2.4, d: 1.6 }); })()

steps.name: readout-pill-visible
steps.failMessage: ResizeHud pill did not mount after publishing a live resize readout (flag on, default)

steps.name: assert-readout-text
steps.eval: (function(){ const t = document.querySelector('.drag-readout')?.textContent || ''; if (!t.includes('2.40') || !t.includes('1.60')) throw new Error('Readout pill text did not match published dims 2.40 x 1.60: ' + t); })()

steps.name: readout-pill-cleared
steps.failMessage: ResizeHud pill did not unmount after clearResizeReadout()

steps.name: assert-readout-hidden-flag-off
steps.eval: (function(){ if (document.querySelector('.drag-readout')) throw new Error('drag-readout pill rendered with itemDimensionReadout flag OFF, even though the signal is live'); })()

steps.name: readout-pill-visible-again
steps.failMessage: ResizeHud pill did not reappear after re-enabling the flag with a still-live signal
